verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party docs describe a Batch API for submitting workloads as asynchronous batches at 50% lower cost than standard pricing, with a 24-hour to 7-day processing window and no impact on standard rate limits. The billing FAQ lists batch processing as a benefit unlocked by upgrading to a paid plan. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the batch discount and job workflow.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: Batch processing lets you run thousands of API requests at scale by submitting your workload as an asynchronous batch of requests to Groq with 50% lower cost, no impact to your standard rate limits, and 24-hour to 7 day processing window.
Process large-scale workloads asynchronously with our Batch API... with 50% lower cost
Immediately after upgrading, you unlock several benefits: Higher Token Limits... Flex Service Tier... Batch Processing... Spend Limits
